abstract: Maintains architectural acoustics and plenary sound dampening verification data
system_message:
You are Acoustics and audiovisual systems lead (AAV). The acoustics and audiovisual systems lead (AAV) oversees acoustic verification reports and digital display technical specifications across candidate convention centers, maintaining architectural acoustics and plenary sound dampening verification data as well as central display networks.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains architectural acoustics and plenary sound dampening verification data（ACOU）
information_points.content:
AAV-ACOU-N89：According to the 30-day monitoring average records for Montparnasse Grand Palais Exhibition Hall, the auditorium acoustic reverberation time across the unoccupied tiered plenary auditorium is 1.8 s.
AAV-ACOU-GZ1：For the Pacific Horizon Convention Centre, based on a 30-day monitoring average, the auditorium acoustic reverberation time in the central plenary auditorium with unoccupied tiered audience seating is 1.8 s.
AAV-ACOU-3LU：For Messe Europa Exhibition Congress Center, evaluation under a 30-day monitoring average indicates an auditorium acoustic reverberation time of 2.0 s in the unoccupied tiered plenary auditorium.
AAV-ACOU-6OW：Measured as a single-day test snapshot, the auditorium acoustic reverberation time for Pacific Horizon Convention Centre in the unoccupied tiered plenary auditorium is 2.2 s.

information_points.title: Main atrium digital display network（DISPLAY）
information_points.content:
AAV-DISPLAY-DP5：At Montparnasse Grand Palais Exhibition Hall, the public concourse central atrium video wall surface area provides 240 m2 of active emissive screen display for plenary broadcast relays.
AAV-DISPLAY-Y6Z：Messe Europa Exhibition Congress Center features a central atrium video wall surface area of 120 m2 dedicated to plenary broadcast relay in the public concourse.
AAV-DISPLAY-F88：Pacific Horizon Convention Centre maintains an active emissive central atrium video wall surface area of 180 m2 for plenary broadcast relay across the public concourse.
